tools.name: ask_kinro_insurance_question
tools.description: Ask Kinro a business insurance question and show the answer in the visible chat.

message.description: A question about business insurance, coverage, quotes, policies, certificates, or renewals.

tools.name: find_insurance_guidance
tools.description: Find and open the most relevant published Kinro industry or coverage guide for a U.S. small business.

businessType.description: The type of small business or work performed, such as lawn care, restaurant, consultant, or electrician.

coverage.description: Optional insurance coverage or concern, such as general liability, workers compensation, commercial auto, or cyber.

tools.name: start_business_insurance_quote
tools.description: Enter a business activity and open Kinro's visible insurance quote flow. This does not submit contact information or request binding.

business_activity.description: The business's primary activity or the type of work it performs.
